column1: # Reviewed package-level side effects in integration-tagged test files (CHAOS-11429).
# gotestfuncs reports a package-level var initializer that calls anything outside its pure list, and a blank or dot
# import, as a hook: the package then runs unfiltered in the integration shards (ci/check_go.sh run_integration_packages).
# A row here says a person READ the callee and it has no global write, no registration and no I/O, so the file does not
# count. Columns: repo path, finding (var-call:<callee> | blank-import:<path> | dot-import:<path>), reason naming what
# was read. A row whose file no longer has that finding fails TestReviewedSideEffectRowsAreNotStale. The pure list in
# ci/tools/gotestfuncs/main.go changes only with the acp's word; a new call goes in this table, not in that list.
# internal/fixturescli has no rows: its init() already keeps the package unfiltered.
